sources.snippet: The benchmark evaluates medical LLM agents on OSCE-style clinical cases. It supports: Static diagnosis: the model receives the full patient record and returns a diagnosis. Diagnostic test: the model starts from history and physical examination information, requests auxiliary examinations, and then makes a final diagnosis. See benchmark/README.md for detailed usage.

sources.title: Salus: Strategic Diagnostic Testing for Complex Diagnosis via...
sources.snippet: Today's AI systems can answer many medical exam questions, but they often do poorly in this back-and-forth process: they may stop too early, choose the wrong tests, or miss rare but serious conditions. We build CompDiag-Bench, a testbed that turns complex diagnosis into an interactive task, and Salus, an AI system trained to reason through it.
